name: MUGE PACKAGING ISO 9001:2015 Certificate Scope Evidence
legal_name: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.

certificate.scope: Production of Packaging Products (Paper Box, Plastic Pouch, Plastic box), excluding items involving administrative license.

safe_public_statement: MUGE PACKAGING is ISO 9001:2015 certified for the production of packaging products, including paper boxes, plastic pouches and plastic boxes, subject to the certificate scope and validity period.
claim_boundary: Do not expand ISO 9001:2015 into FSC, FDA, food-contact, child-safety, environmental or country-specific regulatory compliance claims.
Do not claim customer cases, production capacity, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, price level, or guaranteed compliance for any buyer's target market.
Product-specific regulatory and labeling requirements must be confirmed based on destination market and product category.
